name: poly-load-sidecar
description: After the pattern file is read and closed, load the poly sidecar 'polyA' (A = current pattern letter) from the same project/track working directory straight into the CCM poly array 0x1000B530 + track*0x880. 2176 bytes = 128 steps x [count, note,vel x8]. Skips the drum track (index 3). Hook: 0x0801CD96 (after f_close) -> cave 0x08047C00. Uses f_open 0x0801496C / f_read 0x08014B30 / f_close 0x08014F18. FIL at 0x1000E000, count at 0x1000E300.
